quest.title: The Festering Fang
quest.description: You picked up a strange dragon tooth while adventuring in Dragonspine. Perhaps you should ask around and see if someone knows anything more about it...

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: What do you make of this tooth?

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: A tooth? Ugh, don't tell me you've been foraging around on the mountain for junk...

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: ...Huh, although, as teeth go...

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: What? What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: This is a rather fine specimen. Tough as nails, too...

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: And these contours... Looks an awful lot like Dragontooth to me.

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: What do you mean, "Dragontooth"?

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: As in, the tooth of a dragon. Weapons made from Dragontooth are supposed to be extraordinarily strong and sharp... and even possess some sort of strange power.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: It's hardly the sort of thing you come across every day, though... In all the stories you hear, it's only ever the most famous heroes who manage to acquire Dragontooth and craft weapons from it.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: As they say, if you plan on slaying the dragon to pinch his teeth... you'd better be sure to have a dragon-slayer of a weapon handy, or he might just bite back!

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: Then... is this really a dragon's tooth, or not?

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Honestly, I've never dealt with Dragontooth firsthand, so I can't give a definite answer.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: I do think it has to be the tooth of some enormous beast or other...

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Anyway, since you've gone to all this effort... let's just treat it as if it really is a genuine, precious piece of Dragontooth, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Hmm, but that said — it's not enough to make a weapon from.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: How about you go find, say, three more pieces of Dragontooth, and in the meantime, I'll do some reading and find out how to work with this stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Oh — and <color=#00E1FFFF>Dragontooth</color> aside, we'll want to supplement it with some good ore...

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: In which case, while you're up on the mountain, grab 50 pieces of <color=#00E1FFFF>Starsilver</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Ah yes, and as well as all that... I'm also going to need a <color=#00E1FFFF>Northlander Polearm Billet</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Once you've got all of that, come and see me again.

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: I found some more Dragontooth...

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Ah, I was hoping you'd swing by. Listen, before you go gathering all that Dragontooth... Oh. I see you've already finished.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: My profuse apologies... but I've hit a slight snag. No matter what I hit this thing with, I simply cannot take so much as a sliver off of it.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: It's almost as if it really were Dragontooth... If so, then based on what I read, there are several rather specific methods to work with this material.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: One of them is to have the dragon's tooth absorb some sort of... dragon-related "vitality."

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Then, use the dragon's tooth infused with dragon vitality to work the other pieces of Dragontooth into shape.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: But how to go about infusing something with dragon vitality... I haven't the foggiest idea.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Any thoughts, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: I'll, um... see what I can do.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Great! Here — you take this Dragontooth, then, and I'll leave that whole side of things to you.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Huh, if just the teeth cause this much hassle, whole dragons must be seriously complicated creatures...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, it's... What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks just like a heart, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Can we go now? It really is super creepy here.

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: I'm here about the Dragontooth again...

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: My goodness, the luster... and the texture...

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: You actually managed it? You infused the tooth with dragon vitality? Wow... You are one extraordinary individual, my friend.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: This is great... I've already got someone to handle the Starsilver. Give me a moment or two, I will get this weapon made right away...

talks.objective: Ask the adventurers at the camp for news

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: Any ideas about this tooth?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: A tooth? Let me see.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Hmm... Yes, it is a little unusual, both in shape and in size.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I'm no expert on obscure materials... Orban may know something though, he comes across all sorts of materials in the process of forging weaponry.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Why not go and ask him? He's right over there, you can't miss him.

talks.objective: Talk to Orban

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: There! It's done! Haha! Here, hold that. How does it feel?

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: How much do I owe you?

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Oh, don't worry about paying for it. The chance to work with these materials was a rare pleasure, no need to bring Mora into it.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Alright. I'd say this weapon is ready for an adventure, wouldn't you? I hope you'll take good care of it.

talks.objective: Look for another three Strange Teeth

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Interesting... Something looks a little different about this Dragontooth now. And it seems more ominous, too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's get back and give it to Orban.

dialogues.speaker: Core
dialogues.text: (This strange object seems to be reacting...)

talks.objective: Look for another three Strange Teeth

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Have you been exploring up in the mountains? Alone!? Goodness. I'm impressed...

talks.objective: Look for another three Strange Teeth

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: Take a look at these dragon teeth...

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Wow, these are incredible... Are these genuine Dragontooth?

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: If so... That would be truly amazing.

talks.objective: Look for another three Strange Teeth

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: Thoughts on this Dragontooth?

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: I can't say whether it really is Dragontooth or not, but the quality is superb. A few more like this, supplemented with some Starsilver, and you could definitely make a good weapon from it.

dialogues.speaker: Orban
dialogues.text: As soon as you've gathered all that, bring the goods straight back here.
